question.problem: Find the average value of the function $f(x,y)=3{x}^{2}-y$ on the region $D=\{(x,y)\,:\,0\le x\le 2,\,1\le y\le 3\}.$
question.worked_solution:
First, notice that 

$$
\text{Area}(D)=2\cdot 2=4.
$$

Applying the average value formula, we find that the average value of the function is

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}_{\text{ave}} & =\frac{1}{\text{Area}(D)}\,{∬}_{D}f(x,y)\,\text{d}A \\  & =\frac{1}{4}{∬}_{D}(3{x}^{2}-y)\,\text{d}A \\  & =\frac{1}{4}{\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{1}^{3}(3{x}^{2}-y)\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{1}{4}{\int }_{0}^{2}{[3{x}^{2}y-\frac{{y}^{2}}{2}]}_{y=1}^{y=3}\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{1}{4}{\int }_{0}^{2}(6{x}^{2}-4)\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{1}{4}[2{x}^{3}-4x]_{x=0}^{x=2} \\  & =\frac{1}{4}(2\cdot {2}^{3}-4\cdot 2\cdot 1) \\  & =\frac{8}{4} \\  & =2.\end{aligned}
$$
